info.description:
Complete collection for all Solace automation workflows.

1. Set 'dispatcherUrl' = trigger URL of main-dispatcher workflow
2. Set 'apiToken' = your Solace Cloud API token
3. Run '1. Service / Create Service' — it auto-fills SEMP credentials
4. Run remaining requests in order
